summary: Los Angeles County lookout site at 4,870 ft; built before 1922 per Register, 1936 per county reports; now ruins with cabin remains and 1936 piers.

facts.status_note: The Register describes remains of the wood cabin and dated piers on site. It describes no standing tower

events.note: Register Built field reads Prior to 1922. Newspaper reports had the tower in service by 1922
Sawmill Mountain page says its 30-foot steel tower was moved to Tejon by 1935. Not confirmed as the same structure
County annual report: Tejon Lookout Tower and observer's cabin erected December 1936. Register piers dated 1936
County annual report: an observer is maintained at the tower through cooperation between three counties
Registered April 15, 2020; nominated by Brad Eells

corrections.why: The Register's Built field reads Prior to 1922. 1922 is the year newspaper reports had the tower in service. County reports from 1936 to 1937 describe construction later, so the conflict is noted in resolved_conflicts

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register: built prior to 1922, in service by 1922 per newspapers, piers dated 1936. County annual reports: plans laid by June 1936, tower and observer's cabin erected December 1936. Sawmill Mountain page says a tower was moved to Tejon by 1935. Not resolved in the story.

notes_for_editor: No source read says whether the site is open to the public, so no access key is given. The Register names the county fire department as administrator. A search for Tejon Mountain turned up only Tejon Ranch history pages, which do not mention the lookout, so none are cited. The build date is unresolved: the Register says prior to 1922, while the county annual reports describe a tower erected in December 1936. Confirm with a newspaper or county report before publishing a firm year. The Angeles Adventures link to the Sawmill tower move is not confirmed as the Tejon tower.
